Symbiosis Institute of Business Management, Pune is Constituent of SYMBIOSIS INTERNATIONAL (DEEMED UNIVERSITY) - SIU. Established in 1978, a premier B School in India, SIBM Pune is consistently ranked among the top 10 B Schools of the country. SIBM Pune is recognized for its excellence in academics and its valuable contributions to industry and society and students. SIBM Pune is a member of EFMD & EFMD Global network.

The year 1971 witnessed the birth of ‘SYMBIOSIS’, a story which was yet to be written across the coming decades and would change the lives of millions of young minds, founded by Dr. S.B. Mujumdar with the aim to unite students from all over the world.

SIBM Pune was the first college to be set up under the SYMBIOSIS SOCIETY in the year 1978. With the old campus at Senapati Bapat Road in Pune, the city often referred to as the Oxford of the East due to its status of being the cultural and educational capital of Maharashtra.

Students Testimonials

With world class faculties, facilities and pedagogy, SIBM offers top notch learning experience to it's students. The USP is the experiential learning through all the council activaties which helps the students to put into practical use the theories learnt in class.

Sarath Chandra Prakash A

M.B.A. Batch of 2022

SIBM Pune is known for its student-driven culture where an individual is provided with a launchpad to learn and hone one's management and leadership skills before joining the corporate. This is through participation in student’s council, academic group assignments and case solving as well as case competitions.

Jaykumar Purohit

M.B.A. Batch of 2022

SIBM Pune believes in transforming it's students into holistically developed professionals who learn not just from books, but also from experiences. The industry relevant pedagogy is supplemented by a plethora of extracurricular activities mainly driven by the student council body and SIGs.

Vishakha Vaidywan

M.B.A. Batch of 2022

It's a wholesome experience with good balance amongst academics, co-curricular, and extracurricular activities. The students' council at SIBM Pune is one of it's kind and it provides great opportunities to hone your technical, managerial, and interpersonal skills.

Prathit Desai

M.B.A. Batch of 2022

One thing that stands out for SIBM Pune is its student driven culture. Being a senior member of one of the councils, the Corporate Interface Team, I got to witness that first-hand. The same enables the student to take responsibility, apply management principles and brace for the journey ahead.

Tanisha Jain

M.B.A. Batch of 2022

My B-School motto was "Stay hungry, Stay foolish". I genuinely owe a large part of my overall personality development to SIBM Pune. It helped me to create a holistic perspective and inculcated necessary interpersonal skills. The faculties and student driven culture provided the best in the class learning environment.

Siddharth Patel

M.B.A. Batch of 2022

SIBM Pune with its age old legacy is a home to some amazingly experienced faculties that help students not only in classrooms, but also in their personal growth. The curriculum is well structured and planned strategically to cover all the important aspects of business.

Ruchi Khant

M.B.A. Batch of 2022

As I started my professional journey it was painful for me to part ways with academics – something I truly enjoy and adore. Finally, it was June 2019, when I decided that I am going to take up a professional course. But then, what about job? ..and that’s where I learnt about this excellent M.B.A. (Executive) programme at Symbiosis Institute of Business Management, Pune.

Pooja Ghormade

M.B.A. (Executive) Batch of 2022

Mr. Mahendra Yewale Global Site Leader, Imaging Hardware Platforms Team, Engineering Manager GE Healthcare Bangalore After being in the leadership role for few years, I was always feeling like I am missing the mentorship which can help me grow in my career. I was in constant dilemma like situations whether the way I managed, was it right? Constantly, I was doubting the correctness of the decisions that I was taking.

Mahendra Yewale

M.B.A. (Executive) Batch of 2016

With experience we reach a position where we start managing teams, but many times the way of management may not be the right way. I was looking out for a program that I could pursue along with work but without compromise on quality.

Admission to all the courses and programmes at Symbiosis International (Deemed University) (SIU) are strictly on merit, based on the eligibility criteria, admission criteria and processes prescribed by the University from time to time and assessment of individual performance in different entrance tests / procedures conducted by SIU including Symbiosis National Aptitude Test [SNAP], Symbiosis Entrance Test [SET], Symbiosis Law Admission Test [SLAT], Symbiosis All India Admission Test [AIAT], Symbiosis Entrance Exam for Design [SEED], Symbiosis Institute of Technology Engineering Entrance Exam [SITEEE] and Symbiosis Ph.D. Entrance Test (PET).

It is a matter of Policy that Symbiosis International (Deemed University) does not charge capitation fee for admission from students and this is widely and prominently published as well on all the relevant places like prospectus, website, Admission Booklets, etc.

All aspirants / parents are hereby notified that some individuals and/or organisations are giving / making false and misleading advertisements / claims in newspapers, websites, social media platforms or other means that they can secure/ ensure admission to various programme offered by Symbiosis International (Deemed University). Such individuals or organisations may also seek or demand money from aspirants or their parents in consideration of such purported assurances.

Aspirants and parents are advised to rely only on information and communications issued through the University's official channels, and to independently verify any claim regarding admission made by any third party.

It is informed at large that the University has not authorised or appointed any individual, agent, consultant or organisation to guarantee, assure or otherwise represent that admission to any course or programme, can be secured against payment of money or through any means other than the prescribed admission process. In this regard, Symbiosis International (Deemed University) requests the aspirants / parents to refrain from entering into any transaction with such elements. Despite this Notice, if any aspirant / parent still proceeds with or enters into transaction with such elements, they would be doing so at their own risk and cost.

Symbiosis International (Deemed University) further notifies that any aspirant attempting to approach Symbiosis International (Deemed University) for admission through or at the instances of such agents will be permanently debarred from admission to all the courses and programmes at Symbiosis International (Deemed University).
